samples.question: The image shows a small network of thick black links connecting circular nodes on a white background. One node is green (the start) and one node is red (the goal). Exactly one link is highlighted in orange and is the candidate bridge. Ignoring the orange link as if it were removed, do the green node and the red node remain connected to each other through the remaining black links? Answer yes or no.
